{{Top|leg}}
'''Progesterone''' was a type of chemical secreted by [[Human/Legends|Human]] bodies. [[Gender/Legends|Males]] were unable to make [[testosterone]] without it, while females who were [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]] produced large amounts of this [[Hormone/Legends|hormone]]. It was known to help repair [[Brain/Legends|brain]] damage.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>

When [[Omega Squad]] [[Clone commando/Legends|commando]] [[Fi Skirata]] was injured during a [[Battle of Gaftikar|mission]] and was pronounced brain [[Death/Legends|dead]] by [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bardan Jusik]] [[Force healing/Legends|healed]] him using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], stimulating [[Clan Skirata|Skirata's]] body to secrete large amounts of progesterone.<ref name="o66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Progesterone was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'' that was written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published on [[September 16]], [[2008]].<ref name="o66" />
